name: v1.3.0
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v1.3.0 -->

## What's Changed
### :rocket: New Features
* [Networking] added histogram metrics for gateways latency by @cheina97 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3314
* feat: set affinity and nodeSelector to wg gateway templates by @fra98 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3324
* feat: access API server from remote through EndpointSlices by @fra98 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3318
* [Networking] avoid conntrack for geneve traffic by @cheina97 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3286
* feat: update gateways when template changes by @cheina97 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3326
* [VIrtualKubelet] virtualkubelet net configuration as flag by @cheina97 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3332
* feat(authentication): allow disabling the built-in default ResourceSlice class by @thisiskazem in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3319
* feat: handle creation and configuration of multiple WireGuard tunnels by @MircoBarone in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3226
* [Networking] Geneve tunnel conncheck by @cheina97 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3277
* feat: add extraArgs and pod annotations support for gateway templates by @varnastadeus in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3349
* [Liqoctl] peer multi-virtual-node by @cheina97 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3275
* [Networking] FirewallConfigurationBinding by @cheina97 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3290
* [Networking] RouteConfigurationBinding by @cheina97 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3353
* add ECMP support for <remote-cluster-id>-gw-ext RouteConfiguration by @MircoBarone in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3291
* feat: add watch for network config in shadowendpointslice controller by @Franc-Zar in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3329
* feat(offloading): dynamically update virtualkubelet deployments by @fra98 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3374
* feat(authentication): allow the provider to resolve the ResourceSlice class when unspecified by @thisiskazem in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3348
### :bug: Bug Fixes
* fix: delete stale ip masquerade firewallconfigurations by @fra98 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3316
* fix: disable apiserver proxy IP when liqo-proxy disabled by @fra98 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3317
* fix: serve stub OpenAPI documents from metric-agent by @kariya-mitsuru in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3282
* [VK] Add type=virtual-kubelet label to Liqo virtual nodes by @claudiolor in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3325
* fix: report latency metrics directly from the origin container by @varnastadeus in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3347
* fix: fetch rules/routes once during routeconfiguration reconcile by @varnastadeus in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3352
* fix: genevetunnel conncheck ping remote ip by @fra98 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3359
* fix: restore deepcopy file generation by @claudiolor in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3365
* fix: log only on geneve tunnel creation by @claudiolor in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3369
* fix(vk): filter only offloaded pods on VK stats/summary by @fra98 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3379
* fix(metric-agent): set APIResourceList.APIVersion to v1 by @broshell in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3372
* fix: rework webhook certificates by @claudiolor in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3343
* fix(virtual-kubelet): use webhook auth/authz by @fra98 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3380
* perf(metric-agent): optimize CPU and memory usage with cache by @fra98 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3381
* fix: consolidate gw-ext rules by @varnastadeus in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3357
* fix(internal-network): keep pod route ownership on IP reuse by @cheina97 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3409
* fix: remove default from FW config wildcard value by @claudiolor in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3394
* fix: arm32 integers comparison checks by @fra98 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3422
### :broom: Code Refactoring
* refactor: disable statefult app test by @cheina97 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3354
* refactor: gw-ext reuse constants by @fra98 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3386
### :truck: Dependencies Management
* chore: bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.72.2 to 1.83.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3228
* chore: bump github.com/jackc/pgx/v5 from 5.7.1 to 5.9.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3267
* chore: bump alpine to 3.24.2 by @fra98 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3404
* chore: bump go version to 1.27.2 by @fra98 in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3403
* chore: bump urllib3 from 2.6.3 to 2.8.0 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3396
* chore: bump github.com/containerd/containerd from 1.7.29 to 1.7.36 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3400
* chore: bump helm.sh/helm/v3 from 3.16.2 to 3.20.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3252
* chore: bump oras.land/oras-go/v2 from 2.6.0 to 2.6.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/liqotech/liqo/pull/3405
